map.手册规定全合成机油 1 万 km 或 12 个月先到为准。年行驶 6000 km: The manual sets full synthetic oil at 10000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first. A car covering 6000 km a year must change oil at 12 months because time arrives first; one covering 20000 km reaches the mileage ceiling in about 6 months under standard duty, while severe duty (short trips, dust, heavy loads) cuts that to 80%, i.e. about 5 months. With current mileage at 45000 km and a 10000 km full synthetic interval, the next due mileage is 50000 km, leaving 5000 km.
